panels.gesture: A charming affectionate kiss sent to an unseen admirer: pursed lips, soft eyes, one gloved hand with fingertips just in front of his lips, palm angled outward as he blows the kiss. No hearts or added symbols.

An enigmatic small closed-mouth smile and knowing direct gaze; one gloved index finger held vertically against the center of his lips in a clear shushing gesture. The other fingers are naturally curled.

Comically innocent wide blue eyes and slightly pursed lips, brows lifted; shoulders raised and BOTH open hands held beside his shoulders in a clearly visible what-me shrug, five natural fingers per hand.
Sudden incredulous surprise, eyes wide and mouth slightly rounded; one spread hand at the side of his cheek while the other recoils near the opposite shoulder, elbows kept inside the square.

Half-lidded knowing eyes and a dry crooked smile; BOTH hands near shoulder height make clearly readable AIR QUOTES with the index and middle fingers slightly bent, the other fingers curled. No written quotation marks.

Playfully offended, lifted inner brows and a dramatically open protesting mouth; one hand spread against his upper chest while the BACK of the other hand rests lightly against his forehead. Elegant exaggerated acting without changing face proportions.

Eyes narrowed with wicked amusement, shoulders slightly lifted; one loosely closed gloved hand lightly conceals a private snicker at his mouth, the other forearm tucked close to his ribs. A sly contained laugh, not a hearty open-mouth laugh.

Eyes rolled upward, one brow high, lips pressed in a weary crooked line; one hand makes a small outward dismissive flick from the wrist with relaxed fingers. His other arm hangs easily, not a stop-palm pose.

A shameless self-aware cocky grin and raised eyebrow; one gloved THUMB points back at his own chest in an unmistakable yes-that-was-me gesture, with his other hand at his hip, within the upper-body framing.
